sloka: तमृते शरणं नान्यं पश्यामो ऽत्र दशानन ।स्तुतिभिः प्रणतो भूत्वा तमेव शरणं व्रज ।। ७.१६.३३ ॥
transliteration: tamṛte śaraṇaṁ nānyaṁ paśyāmo 'tra daśānana ।stutibhiḥ praṇato bhūtvā tameva śaraṇaṁ vraja ।। 7.16.33 ॥

translations.english: "O ten-headed one, we see no other refuge here except him; therefore, having bowed down with praises, seek refuge in him alone."
